technical.summary: Strong short-term bullish setup with golden cross and three white soldiers, but extreme RSI9 overbought condition and weak ADX trend confirmation create pullback risk; longer-term structure below 200-MA suggests caution on swing hold.

fundamental.summary: FAST shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 73 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and non-directional (junior member, small amounts); market fear (44 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and bearish AAII sentiment (40%) prevent conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (348.8) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 73 days presents binary event risk in a highly volatile environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross (EMA 9/21), three white soldiers, and supertrend bullish with rising OBV provide short-term momentum setup at support (23.056), offering defined risk entry in fear-zone opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: RSI 9 falling from extreme overbought (84.58), price below 200-MA/50-SMA, weak ADX (22.29), inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (348.8), zero fundamental catalysts, and earnings binary event in 73 days create severe pullback and macro headwind risk that outweighs technical setup.
